questions.question: By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct? 5 and 9
questions.questionHtml:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?
5 and 9
questions.solution:
1) 9 – 5 × 4 + 6 ÷ 3 = 30

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

5 – 9 × 4 + 6 ÷ 3 = 30

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

5 – 9 × 4 + 2 = 30

⇒ 5 – 36 + 2 = 30

⇒ 7 - 36 = 30

⇒ - 29 ≠ 30

The given equation is incorrect.

2) 9 × 3 + 5 ÷ 1 – 6 = 20

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

5 × 3 + 9 ÷ 1 – 6 = 20

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

5 × 3 + 9 – 6 = 20

⇒ 15 + 9 - 6 = 20

⇒ 24 - 6 = 20

⇒ 18 ≠ 20

The given equation is incorrect.

3) 7 × 9 + 5 – 8 ÷ 4 = 40

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

7 × 5 + 9 – 8 ÷ 4 = 40

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

7 × 5 + 9 – 2= 40

⇒ 35 + 9 - 2 = 40

⇒ 44 - 2 = 40

⇒ 42 ≠ 40

The given equation is incorrect.

4) 9 × 4 + 5 – 8 ÷ 2 = 25

After interchanging the numbers 5 and 9, we get

5 × 4 + 9 – 8 ÷ 2 = 25

Applying the BODMAS Rule, we get

5 × 4 + 9 – 4 = 25

⇒ 20 + 9 – 4 = 25

⇒ 29 - 4 = 25

⇒ 25 = 25

The given equation is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is '9 × 4 + 5 – 8 ÷ 2 = 25'.

questions.solution: The 1887 Davy Medal was awarded to John Alexander Newlands for discovering the periodic law of chemical elements. He created a table of elements grouped by atomic weight and named it the Law of Octaves. Other pioneers include AEB de Chancourtois, Dmitri Mendeleev, and Julius Lothar Meyer, who created early versions of the periodic table.

questions.question: Which of the following Acts of the British Parliament stated that a member of the British Cabinet was appointed Secretary of State for India?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following Acts of the British Parliament stated that a member of the British Cabinet was appointed Secretary of State for India?
questions.solution: The GoI Act of 1858 transferred control of India from the East India Company to the British Crown, with Lord Stanley becoming the first Secretary of State for India. The Indian Councils Act of 1861 changed the executive council into a cabinet, while the Regulating Act of 1773 restructured the East India Company's administration and the Charter Act of 1853 extended the company's charter.

questions.solution: The Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757 by the English Company against the Nawab of Bengal due to misuse of trade privileges. The East India Company won the battle with the help of Mir Jafar, who defected from the Nawab's side. The battle took place at Palashi, on the banks of the Hooghly River. Murshid Quli Khan was the first Nawab of Bengal, while the title of the kings who ruled Awadh was "Nawab of Awadh" or "Nawab of Oudh."

questions.solution: Aspartame is an artificial non-saccharide sweetener that is 200 times sweeter than sugar. It is commonly used as a substitute for sugar in foods and beverages. It has the chemical formula C14 H18 N2 O5 ​ and is a methyl ester of aspartic acid/phenylalanine dipeptide. Saccharin, sucralose and neotame are also artificial sweeteners with different chemical structures and levels of sweetness.

questions.question: Techniques of making silk were first invented in China around _____ years ago.
questions.questionHtml: Techniques of making silk were first invented in China around _____ years ago.
questions.solution: Silk was first invented in China around 7000 years ago through the process of sericulture. Legend has it that Princess Xi Lingshi discovered the process when a cocoon dropped into her tea and unravelled to produce a thread. The silkworm, specifically the Bombyx Mori, is the key to silk production and lays 500 eggs in 5 days before dying. The Silk Route, a network of trade routes spanning over 6,400 kilometres, played a central role in facilitating economic, cultural, political, and religious interactions between the East and West from the second century BCE until the mid-15th century.

questions.questionHtml: Polar easterlies are which kind of winds?
questions.solution: Polar easterlies are permanent winds that blow from the east and emanate from the polar highs. They flow to sub-polar regions. questions.question: Abha and Anuj working together completed a job in \(40\over9\) days. If Abha had worked twice as efficiently as she actually did and Anuj had worked \(1 \over 3\) of his actual efficiency, then the work would have been completed in \(60 \over 17\) days. Find the time Abha would take to complete the work alone
questions.questionHtml: Abha and Anuj working together completed a job in \(40\over9\) days. If Abha had worked twice as efficiently as she actually did and Anuj had worked \(1 \over 3\) of his actual efficiency, then the work would have been completed in \(60 \over 17\) days. Find the time Abha would take to complete the work alone
questions.solution:
(Abha + Anuj) × 40/9 = [(2 × Abha) + (1/3 × Anuj)] × 60/17

⇒ 34 Abha + 34 Anuj = 54 Abha + 9 Anuj ⇒ 25 Anuj = 20 Abha ⇒ Anuj/Abha = 4/5

The efficiency, ⇒ Abha = 5 units/day & Anuj = 4 units/day

Total units of work ⇒ (5 + 4) × 40/9 = 40 units .

Total number of days required by Abha to complete the work ⇒ 40/5 = 8 days

questions.solution:
The relative speed between police and thief = (10 - x) km/h = (10 - x) × \(\frac{5}{18}\) m/sec.

Distance between Police and thief is = 100m

 (10 - x) ×\(\frac{5}{18}\) = \(\frac{100}{3×60}\) ⇒ (10 - x) = \(\frac{100×18}{3×60×5}\) = 2 ⇒ x = 10 - 2 = 8 km/h

Average speed = \(\frac{2 \times 45 \times 80}{(45 + 80)}\) = 288/5 = 57.6 km/hr

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the correct collocation. Of course, we agree with that measure, it is _________ sensible.

Of course, we agree with that measure, it is _________ sensible.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: perfectly.

Key Points

  • The correct collocation to be used here is perfectly.
  • Collocation is two or more words that often go together.
  • The collocation to be used here is: adverb + adjective.
  • Example: 
    • Are you fully aware of the consequences of leaving the company now? 
  • The phrase "perfectly sensible" means completely reasonable, logical, or rational.
    • Example sentence: The decision to extend the deadline for the project was perfectly sensible given the unforeseen circumstances.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.


Correct Sentence: Of course, we agree with that measure, it is perfectly sensible.​Additional Information

  •  Other types of collocations are:
  1. adjective + noun (excruciating pain)
  2. noun + noun (round of applause)
  3. noun + verb (bomb went off)
  4. verb + noun (commit suicide)
  5. verb + expression with preposition (burst into tears)
  6. verb + adverb (wave frantically)

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. If things get out of control, competition might become totally toxic.
B. Competition is the act of participating in a contest and the strive to finish first.
C. Competition enables those who effectively deal well enough to grow and realise their skills and talents.
D. The essence of competition is placing oneself against one’s contemporaries and frequently against oneself.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BDCA'.
Key Points

  • The correct order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph is BDCA.
  • The first sentence, B, introduces the concept of competition and defines it as the act of participating in a contest and striving to finish first.
  • The second sentence, D, explains the essence of competition as placing oneself against one's contemporaries and frequently against oneself. This sentence further elaborates on the definition of competition provided in the first sentence.
  • The third sentence, C, highlights the benefits of competition, stating that it enables individuals to grow and realize their skills and talents if they effectively deal well enough.
  • The last sentence, A, provides a cautionary note about the potential negative consequences of competition if things get out of control and it becomes toxic.
  • Therefore, the correct order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph is BDCA.
     

Correct Sequence: Competition is the act of participating in a contest and the strive to finish first. The essence of competition is placing oneself against one’s contemporaries and frequently against oneself. Competition enables those who effectively deal well enough to grow and realise their skills and talents. If things get out of control, competition might become totally toxic.
